tapeLine: Monday 9 November: S&P 500 +173.08 (+2.3%) to 7,549.94; Dow +1,104.02 (+2.1%) to 52,389.75; Nasdaq Composite +2.7% to 25,253.14, per Monday close reports. Tuesday futures were not found.
matters:
Stocks rallied sharply on Monday, recovering part of last week’s AI-led sell-off. Reports tied the move to lower oil prices on easing Iran tension and a tech rebound; AMD rose about 13% while Nvidia fell about 4% on a report that its board is investigating its CEO.

The Dow closed above its Election Day level; the S&P 500 and Nasdaq were reported slightly below theirs. One strong session does not settle the direction of the correction.
